item.text:
The dashboard now pre-renders its heading and placeholders for the stats, revenue, and invoices sections. In [page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx), data fetching happens inside Suspense boundaries so it no longer holds up the shell. I also enabled partial prefetching in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts).

`npm run build` passes and reports `/` as **Partial Prerender**. I checked the generated HTML and confirmed it contains the heading and all three placeholders; TypeScript and `git diff --check` also pass.

Live data still depends on the configured `https://api.example.com/dashboard` endpoint.
